description: This is a Python test utility file related to PyTorch's distributed sharded tensor operations. It contains functions to generate sharding specifications, compute sharded weight parameters, clone module parameters, and generate binary operation functions for testing purposes.

methods.name: generate_chunk_sharding_specs_for_test(sharding_dim)
methods.description: Generates a list of ChunkShardingSpec objects with different ordering for testing sharding across a specified dimension.

methods.name: generate_enumerable_sharding_specs_for_test()
methods.description: Creates an EnumerableShardingSpec object with multiple shard metadata entries to test enumerable sharding specifications.

methods.name: generate_local_weight_sharding_params_for_test( local_weight, sharded_dim, gpu_num, spec, rank )
methods.description: Calculates start position and chunk size for a sharded weight tensor based on a provided sharding spec, local weight tensor, and process rank.

methods.name: clone_module_parameter(module, param_name)
methods.description: Clones a specified parameter from a given module, returning it as a detached, cloned tensor wrapped as a parameter.

methods.name: gen_binary_op_func(python_op, inplace=False)
methods.description: Dynamically generates a binary operation function (e.g., add, subtract) with optional in-place operation support.
